subject: Minor support log discrepancy
text:
Good morning,

I am writing to report a minor issue with yesterday’s support log. A colleague misread a calendar entry and treated the scheduled clinic as a regular meeting slot. The result was a brief gap in coverage, not a missed appointment.

I reviewed the system and adjusted the label so future entries will distinguish between clinical time and ordinary calendar blocks. I also added a reminder that appears thirty minutes before the event. I will keep this ticket open until the corrected entry is visible in your shared portal by Thursday.

There is no immediate risk to the current semester schedule, but I wanted you to know because your office handles related communications. Please let me know if you would like a short written summary for the department file.
